additional_info.body:
Dear Marco,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Mohini
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R7 170002200
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
xgesXO
Problem Description
: HMI black
Troubleshooting
:
According to the issue reported, the terminal screen is black. Following the suggested action on your side should help resolve the problem.
1. Please restart the charger.
2.You will need to change the shielded and shortened DP cable. Please replace the DP cable with a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part and NOT any other DP cable). Also please route the DP cable as far as possible from routers, R&D found out that this component is affecting the EMC performance.
3.Also please check the 24VDC power supply. it should be set to 25VDC.
Please find the work instruction for black screen issue and if you have any help, please reach out to us.
SI E Q-Feedback Q2301 Sicharge D - HMI Blackout Due To RFID Illumination - ID: 109816643 - Industry Support Siemens
For future reference, your ticket number is
0382174
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil

additional_info.subject: RE: 0382174 - ID0382174-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / R7 170002200] HMI black CRM:00314000123
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
I hope this email finds you well.
First, I want to extend my gratitude to Gazmend for the continued support during the intervention. We assisted with the intervention yesterday (10/10/2024), but it was not fully completed. We successfully replaced the HMI and confirmed that the Touch & RFID are working. However, for the Valina Payment Terminal, we encountered issues, as there were no mounting instructions or bolts/nuts provided with the CCT MLFB. Only two clamps were included with the CCT. The region managed to mount it, but it has not yet been commissioned. This issue should be brought to the attention of the relevant team as there are no mounting instructions & hardware available.
While the region was trying to charge the vehicle, we faced additional issues. The EV is connected, and the charging process appears to be initiating, but it’s not delivering any power (0 kW). We noticed multiple errors in the SCB indicating missing converters in DC3/DC4. The dispenser is intentionally set as inoperative due to a hardware failure and is not powered on, which requires changes in the PLC configuration. However, we are still seeing missing converter errors for DC3/DC4.
After rebooting the charger, we experienced issues with the Siemens router, as the charger showed as offline on the SCB. Upon checking with a laptop, we noticed two mobile connections to the router. We reset it to default using MobaXterm but struggled to stabilize the SCB connection due to weak network strength.
After another reboot, we observed that during the converter grouping process, only 7 out of 15 converters were completed before the charger went into fast shutdown. The logs indicate that the converters are not powering on after the seventh one. The charger is a Highflex model with a power rating of 300 kW. We lowered the power to 140 kW & the necessary changes in the PLC configuration, which allowed us to charge the vehicle from the DC2 outlet, but we still cannot charge from the DC1 outlet.
Given the late hour, we need to schedule the next site intervention to check all converter connections, as it’s unlikely that all eight converters are faulty. It would be beneficial to discuss with Marco regarding the spare parts that needs to be replaced in the dispenser, so we can resolve these issues in one go.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

additional_info.subject: RE: 0382174 - ID0382174-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / R7 170002200] HMI black CRM:00314000123
additional_info.body:
Hi Jose,
Greetings of the day!
I wanted to provide an update on today's (10/15/2024) intervention. As a background from the previous intervention, we have been struggling to get vehicles charged at Outlet 1. Today, we checked the wiring and found that DC2 is working again, but DC1 is still not operational. During the charging sequence, when it reaches the 'Start Charge-->Charge',  the pilot state instantaneously changes from 'C2' to 'E' or 'B2.' We also encountered an "Error Polling CoAP" after the session was terminated, which we resolved by swapping the Ethernet cables from KF11 and KF12 to the Ethernet switch. However, we are still facing issues with SCB connectivity due to very weak signal strength near the charger.
We successfully changed the Network Operator to Swisscom, which stabilized afterwards. We attempted multiple charging sessions on the DC1 outlets, changing the log level to Debug and checking the charging session in the Debug Station, but it still does not charge after reaching the C2 state. After consulting with experts, we discovered that one of the power converters in the DC1 configuration appears to have an issue
(Converter Power ON Fails during charging (Auto voltage mode reset)). Within the fraction of seconds the error disappear so its also not visible in the SCB error flags.
W
e could try removing the front panel of the power converter, but the regional person on site is not electrical trained, so we cannot proceed with removing the faulty power converter. This will need to be postponed until the next site intervention. Below is the MLFB for the power converter, which you can order for replacement:
Defective Power Converter :
2102312VGQKXNB000047SA002200000200FW:DC116PF116H100,F:1
MLFB for the power converter :
Regarding the PLC in the dispenser, which you have already ordered, it needs to be replaced later this week, as discussed. The picture you shared indicates significant issues, including melting spots.
Additionally, this case was opened regarding the HMI black issue, which was resolved during the previous intervention, and the touch and RFID functionalities are working. We will create a new case
(0384751) f
or the DC1 outlet charging issue and the PLC in the dispenser, while closing this case as the HMI issue has been resolved.
Thank you for your continued support during the intervention.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
